name: White
title: The Unbroken Light
description: The eldest known Fragment, White carries the first memory of a world before the Sundering. Their radiance does not illuminate—it reveals what reality has tried to forget.

name: Black
title: The Final Shadow
description: Black is the certainty at the end of every prophecy. Crowned in the void between stars, he commands the merciful silence that follows all things.

name: Red
title: The Wound That Walks
description: Every oath broken in anger feeds Red's furnace-heart. She is worshipped by conquerors and feared by those who understand that desire is merely war turned inward.
